tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (627)༄༅/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi bstan srung khyad par du 'phags pa mgon po gri gug ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa gdug pa kun 'joms zhes
(627)༄༅/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi bstan srung khyad par du 'phags pa mgon po gri gug ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa gdug pa kun 'joms zhes

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (627)༄༅// dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi bstan srung khyad par du 'phags pa mgon po gri gug ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa gdug pa kun 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(628)༄༅// thugs mchog rdo rje'i rigs las byung*// chos nyid mi 'gyur mun pa'i mdog /brten na dngos grub kun stsol ba// gang der 'dud do rjes brtser mdzod/ /jo bo bka' gdams pa'i bstan srung zab cing myur la mthu stobs che ba mgon po gri gug ma sgrub cing rjes su gnang ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni rten gyi spyan sngar stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng maṇ+ḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu dbus su gcig de'i g.yon tu gcig /mdun tu'ang gnyis phreng bsgrigs su bkod/ rgyab tu mañji'i steng du gtor ma nor gzugs ma kha zas bzang dgus brgyan pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas su sku rten/ g.yon tu sngags byang dang thod pa dam rdzas dang bcas pa/ mdun tu gri gug rnams bkod la// de dag gi mdun tu mchod pa phreng tshar du bsgrig /de'i mdun tu 'bul gtor dang nang mchod bsham mo/ gnyis par dang po sgrub mchod ni/ skyabs sems sngon tu 'gro bas phyag na rdo rje dang mi g.yo ba gang rung gi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las (629)mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos// mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍer ṇi ta sogs kyis byin dbab/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ oṃ stong par gyur/ āḥthod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ hūm̐ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi mdun tu 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/

paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ṇ-i las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bam chen brtsegs pa'i gdan la hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ ma hā ka la sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod (630)pa snying bcas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bskyod pa/ sma ra/ smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags shing gsus khyim che ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas pad nyi mi ro'i gdan la/ me chen drag po 'bar ba'i klong na bzhengs pa'o/ /yang na stag lpags kyi sham thabs mi mdzad par dar nag gi 'jol ber gser gyi ske rags can dang*/ zhabs la mag ti'i lha ma yu ring gsol bar byas kyang rung*/ gtso bo'i g.yon du rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ bh+yoḥlas 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sngon mo ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ srin mo bong bu gwa dmar gyi steng na btsan skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ rak+ta'i rgya mtshor rgyug pa'o// gtso bo'i mdun gyi 'og phyogs su/ pad nyi dang bam chen bsnol ba'i gdan la/ phaṭa las las kyi mgon po sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis smyan gsum pa/ g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing chen dang*/ g.yon lcags par bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ bing stong nas me 'bar ba/ beng smad nas chu 'khrugs pa/ bing gi nang nas lha dang lha ma yin gyi dmag tshogs 'gyed pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gser gyi ska rags can gsol pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de'i g.yon tu maṃ las ma gcig e ka dzā ṭī sku mdog smug nag ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la bcibs pa/

phyi rol du phyogs skyong zhing skyong sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ (631)mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying gnas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥhūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la gshegs// 'jigs byed bstan srung yongs kyi gtso// zag med dbyings nas gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa pa ri bā ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ maha ka la gṛh+ṇe daṃ/ ār+ghaṃ swā hā nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ zhes dam la bzhag /oṃ ma hā kā la sa pa ri bā ra a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis/ ye shes mgon po dang 'khor rnams so so'i snying po'i mthar/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa dang*/ shā sa nas kyang 'bul/ spyi khyab tu a kā ro lan gsum gyis bstab/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma lus 'joms mdzad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /mthar byed gzhon nu 'jigs byed gang rgyangs can// mnyam nyid thugs mnga' gtum chen me ltar 'bar// bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma khyod la bstod/ /ces pa'o/ /thugs kar sngags phreng gsal btab la/ oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ni las kyi sngags so/ /oṃ shrī di wī hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'dod khams ma'i mtshan sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā kā la rak+ṣa du be pa ṇi dzaḥdzaḥ las mgon gyi sngags so/ /oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yo dza dzaḥ e ka dzā ṭi'i sngags te gtso 'khor gyi 'gros dang sbyar nas ci nus bzla/

gtor chog rkyang pa la 'di nas mchod bstod sogs (632) rjes rim rnam bya/ rjes gnang skabs bzlas pa grub pa'i mtshams su rjes gnang gi rim pa rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du dmigs pas len/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral la 'khod/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ chos bshad ci rigs pa dang khyad par/ de'ang bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i spyan sngar dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam tshig can gyi srung ma ji snyed cig mchis pa'i nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa ni dpal he ru ka'i mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo las sprul pa'i ye shes kyi ma mgon lcam dral rnams yin la// de la'ang rigs dang sde tshan gyi dbye bas phye ba dang*/ rgyud dang man ngag gi bka' srol 'phags bod gnyis su mtha' yas pa byon pa'i nang nas/ 'dir skabs su bab pa/ sa gsum du snyan par grags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag jo bo rje mar me mdzad dpal ye shes nas brtsams te lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams rin po che'i bstan pa'i srung mar mnga' gsol ba/ legs ldan mgon po sde lnga'i nang nas thugs mgon gri gug gi rigs chos skyong bzhi sbrags su grags pa'i rjes su gnang bsgrub pa la bdag nyid kyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa mtha' dag gi 'jug sgo skyabs su 'gro ba dang theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhi rten byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa tshul bzhin gsal (633)thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/

sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /sogs lan gsum/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du rgyun bshags sngon tu 'gro ba can gyi byang chub kyi sems dang dam tshig sdom pa mtha' dag tshul bzhin tu 'dzin par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ de nas rjes gnang dngos la gsum du yod pa las dang po sku'i rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ slob dpon nyid bdag bskyed khro bo gang bsgom pa de'i mngon rtogs ltar gsal 'debs/ mdun tu 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bam chen rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la ma hā kā la sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa sogs mngon rtogs ltar la/ 'khor rnams sa bon las bskyed pa'i tshig dor/ 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba gsal thob cig /slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pas// slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs kar phog pas/ thugs rgyud bskul/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ nag po chen po'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung la rdul phran tsam dpag tu med pa spyan drangs lus la thim par mos shig /ces brjod la rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs bya'o// maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas kyi sku rten spyi bor bzhag la/ mi 'bral sku yis byin brlabs pas// bstan dang 'khor bzhi skyong ba dang*// gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod phyir// nag po chen po'i sku 'di bzung*// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ kā ya sa ma ya dhā ra hūm̐/ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi sdig (634)sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du/

slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba'i tshogs dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim zhes brjod/ mgon po'i sngags byang dang*/ thod pa lag pa g.yon tu gtad/ mi 'bral gsung gis byin brlabs pas// sna tshogs phrin las sgrub pa dang*// nag po chen po mnyes byed pa// gsung gi rig sngags bzung bar bya// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ wā ka sa ma ya dhā ra hūm̐/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung blang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'phros/ zhal nas 'thon te khyed rang rnams kyi khar zhugs/ snying gar nyi steng hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/ snying po ngang las sngags lan gsum re bzlar gzhug /slob dpon la me tog gi phreng ba re phul bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas spyi bor bcings par mos shig /bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// rdo rje nag po chen po'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus pa mtha' dag rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig /des gsung (635)gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i gsang sngags bzla ba la dbang ba yin no// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du/

slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pas// slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ mdun bskyed mgon po dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas gri gug thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ snying gar thim zhes brjod la rol mo bya/ gri gug lag pa g.yas su gtad de / mi 'bral thugs kyis byin brlabs pas// slob dpon rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin tu// brtse ldan drag po'i phrin las kyis// ma rung sems can bsgral bar bya// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ tsit+ta sa ma ya dhā ra hūm̐/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ yid kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi// rdo rje nag po chen po'i thugs 'od gsal bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no// mtha' rten gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba la/ gtor ma 'di nyid rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa dngos su gsal ba/ slob dpon gyis bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas smos shing dam tshig gi bka' bsgos pa tsam gyis ji ltar bsgo ba'i phrin las rnams thogs med du bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par mos shig /gtor ma mgor bzhag la/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bram ze mchog sred/ rā hu la/ jo bo rje a ti sha/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhing ston chos 'byung*/ sangs rgyas sgom pa nas rim par byon pa'i rtsa (636)ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs la bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang slob ma 'di zhes bya ba'i lus dang grib ma bzhin tu 'grogs te/ lus ngag yid gsum bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs bka' bsgo rgyas bsdus spyi dang mthun par bya/

gtor ma'i mtheb kyu nas rdo rje'i rtse mos cung zad blangs kā pa la'i bdud rtsi dang sbrags te/ slob ma la cung zad sbyin/ gtor ma la'ang bdud rtsi cung zad bran ste/ nag po chen po khyod kyis slob ma 'di'i chos skyong gyis la byin pa'i zas zos/ bcol ba'i las gyis/ zhes brjod/ des dpal ldan mar me mdzad las brgyud pa'i bka' gdams bstan pa'i srung ma khyad par can mgon po gri gug bzhi sbrags kyi rjes su gnang ba grub pa yin pas rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig spyi dang khyad par nag po chen po lcam dral gyi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin tu bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar/ sogs/ gtong rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus 'bul/ dge bsngo rnams spyi ltar bya/ gsum pa cho ga'i rjes kyi rim pa ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la sngar bzhin gyis brlabs/ sngags kyis phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ mchod phreng ni/ hūm̐/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas la// bdag gis mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi// dmar chen khrag gi ār+ghaṃ dang*// dbang po lnga yi me tog dang*// rus pa rkang klad bsres pa'i spos// zhun chen gsal ba'i sgron me dang*// rdo rje rang byung dri chab dang*// sha chen sna lnga'i zhal zas dang*// rkang gling thod rnga snyan pa'i sgra// dngos 'byor yid sprul mkha' bkang nas// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la (637)'bul// gzhan yang mchod pa 'bul ba ni// 'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad dang*// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman// dgra bgegs rnam gnyis bsgral ba yi// don snying sha rus gtor chen bsham// de bzhin tshe 'dzin khrag gi rgyun// ban+dha lcang lo khrag gis bkang*// bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mthun pa'i rdzas su bzhes par mdzod// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// zhing chen bla bre 'phan gdugs dang*// rgyu rlon lda ldi snying phreng dpyangs// keng rus sna tshogs ri ltar spungs// sha khrag dri bsur rgyun mi 'chad// sna tshogs rgyan gyi mchod pa 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/

/bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jig byed pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che// gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas// g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod// thod phreng can la bdag bstod do// khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo// 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel// dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa// dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /ces dang*/ jo bos mdzad par grags pa'i bstod pa che chung rnams kyang shes na 'don/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus// 'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas// 'dod pa'i khams la dbang sgyur ma// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la (638)'dud// drag mo mi sdug gtum pa'i sku// lha yi dmag dpon chen po ste// lha min g.yul du pham mdzad pa'i// rdo rje beng khyod phyag 'tshal bstod// dga' tshal mdzes pa'i lha mo ni// gdug pa 'dul phyir srin po'i sku// dgra bgegs sha dang khrag la rngam// rdzong mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang*// ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang cher mtho zhing*// bstan 'dzin sku tshe legs brtan nas// rnam dkar phrin las rgyas par mdzod// khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon dgra bgegs zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas nas// thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces phrin las bcol/ yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med pa'am gtor mgron gshegs su gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis spyi dang mthun par bya'o// rgyal bstan phul byung bka' gdams pa'i// bstan 'tshe'i bdud rigs tshar gcod cing*// bstan pa'i srog zung nub med du// rab brtan rtsa lag nyid gyur cig

/ces gangs ljongs sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi khrid srol gces dgu snying po bsdus pa gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod las bka' gdams chos srung khyad par 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang bklags pas chog pa 'di'ang ku sā li blo gros mtha' yas kyis rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub gnas su rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rabs las khol du phyungs te bkod pa dge legs 'phel/// /
